name: Audio-Reactive Raymarched Music Video
description: My Advanced Computer Graphics final project: a music video drawn live by a single GLSL shader as the song plays, driven by its beats and frequencies.
highlights: Raymarched scenes built from signed distance functions, including a Menger Sponge fractal, a Mandelbrot zoom and fluid-style distortion
Synced to the music: an FFT of each audio chunk drives the frequency bars as it plays, and beats and onsets pre-analysed with Librosa trigger pulses and scene changes
Runs on OpenGLApp, my own Python creative-coding framework (shown as its own project)
